title: zesty sweet german oranges pudding
description: a traditional german dessert featuring oranges, dashi extract, and a hint of umami flavor, suitable for those with dietary restrictions
instructions: in a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and granulated sugar until light and fluffy.
add the dashi extract to the egg yolk mixture and whisk until well combined.
in a separate saucepan, combine the orange juice and butter over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
remove from heat and slowly pour the egg yolk mixture into the orange juice mixture, whisking constantly.
return to heat and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
remove from heat and stir in the heavy cream and vanilla extract.
pour the pudding into individual serving cups or ramekins.
chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight before serving.
serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of granulated sugar and a few slices of orange, if desired.
note: this pudding will have a slightly shaggy texture due to the dashi extract, which adds a unique umami flavor.
if a smoother consistency is desired, strain the pudding through a fine-mesh sieve before chilling.
